summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX): the detailed packet of an index becomes an index Quote frame with the change worked out from the previous close.

notes: Whether Pocketful streams indices with the detailed layout, and with what in the trade fields, needs a live check.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds; the web passes the seconds on as ltt (1762656900), the desktop sends epoch milliseconds (1762656900000), the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.
The desktop sends an index's change from its LTP and previous close for every broker (as the recorded Zerodha index transcript); this web adapter sends no change in a Quote frame.
The desktop sends an index's change percent from its LTP and previous close for every broker (as the recorded Zerodha index transcript); this web adapter sends none.
An index frame carries no trade quantity, average or book totals on the desktop, for every broker (the recorded Zerodha index transcript); the web passes on the index packet's zeros.
